title: Braised Callaloo with Wilted Spinach
description: A keto twist on the classic Caribbean dish, featuring braised callaloo and wilted spinach.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Sauté garlic and onions until softened.
Add callaloo and cook until wilted.
Add braised kale and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs (optional).
For an added keto touch, top with a fried egg or a sprinkle of grated cheddar.
